next.reason: 1985: "the value of the index after the execution of the SET statement must correspond to an occurrence number of an element in the table"; 2023: "even if that occurrence is not a valid occurrence within this table". 1985 requires SET index values to lie within the table. 2023 allows occurrences outside it and raises EC-RANGE-INDEX only outside the OCCURS GR2 limit (1 - integer-2 to 2 * integer-2).
